reason: Write methods on the old public URLs (reference tables, products, metadata, quotation settings) are not shimmed (PLAN §6.2: an unauthenticated write surface was a defect; Studio writes through /api/v1/). The legacy answered 401 to an anonymous write.
GET on the POST-only calculator endpoints: the legacy permission class answered 401 (a method without the public marker needed a login); the shim answers 405 like any POST-only endpoint.
The legacy GET of these URLs was the Studio's list (login required); Studio reads moved to /api/v1/ (PLAN §6.2), the shim serves the public POST only.
The legacy GET of lead-collection-home was the Studio Leads screen (Studio token required); Studio reads moved to /api/v1/leads/.
A slash-less POST made the legacy APPEND_SLASH raise RuntimeError (HTTP 500); the shim answers the same 301 to the slashed URL as for any other method.

Legacy HTTP 500 on malformed input (a number that does not parse, an unknown sort column, 1e400/NaN values, a non-object body): the shim answers 400 {"error": …} / {"errors": […]} (DV-90 for the quote, calculators-emi DV-81…86 for the calculators, DV-132 for products).
Legacy HTTP 500 (Django ValidationError page) on a filter value that does not parse (isFeatured=maybe, a bad date): the canonical delivery answers 400 invalid_filter (content-blog decision).

filters[isFeatured][$eq]=true|false: the legacy passed the text to a Django BooleanField, which only accepts True/False/t/f/1/0, and crashed (HTTP 500); the canonical delivery reads true/false as booleans (content-blog decision).
Business default B-1: the public quote never carries the internal cost breakdown and totals (cost, margin). Every other key — bom_lines, pricing, meta, available_offers — is byte-identical (checked).
A leading trunk zero (09876500018) is a valid spelling of an Indian mobile; the legacy regex refused it (leads-customers decision, approved there).

The UAT legacy stack runs with fake Twilio credentials: every send failed at the proxy and leaked the exception text with a 400; the platform's fake OTP backend sends (production: the same Twilio Verify service).

The legacy tried to send an SMS to any country (and leaked the Twilio exception text); the platform refuses non-Indian mobiles before calling the provider (toll-fraud guard, leads-customers decision).
Same status; the legacy leaked the Twilio/proxy exception text, the platform answers "The code is not correct." (no provider text reaches the website).

The legacy 201 body printed the resume/portfolio media paths and Studio download URLs of the stored files; resumes are private on the platform (PLAN §1.4, served to staff only through signed URLs), so the shim answers null for the four file fields. Every other field is compared after the created-row normalisation.
Content sniffing refuses a text file named .pdf (unsupported_file_type); the legacy checked the name only (careers-reference decision).
A CLOSED posting refuses applications (position_not_open); the legacy form accepted any posting (careers-reference decision).
